name: Kuze Airi
source:
An up-and-coming idol.
Despite her innocent, young appearance, her character is mature in a bad way.
She takes advantage of her good looks and popularity and always tries to be selfish.
She believes that the world revolves around her, so she will never tolerate anyone who is more popular than her.
For this reason, she routinely hires people to humiliate prominent idols. Naturally, she has earned a considerable number of grudges, but she is not bothered by this at all。
